# Three.js r180 / 0.180.0

Self-hosted ESM build from mrdoob/three.js tag r180: build/three.module.min.js and build/three.core.min.js. MIT license included verbatim. No CDN, import map, eval or remote HDR required at runtime.

Loaded only after a visible cinematic scene passes the reduced-motion, Save-Data and hardware gates. Invitation template previews/guest pages do not import this renderer. The separate material uses MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission, IOR, thickness and a local procedural PMREM environment. This is rasterized physical transmission, not path-traced caustics.
